title: anthyllis vulneraria f. albiflora
intro: Anthyllis vulneraria f. albiflora, commonly known as White Kidney-vetch, is a flowering plant in the legume family. It has been traditionally used for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, making it useful in treating wounds, burns, and skin conditions. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its ability to stimulate tissue repair, reduce inflammation, and promote wound healing, due in part to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and coumarins. The bioactive constituents of White Kidney-vetch also have antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its effectiveness in treating infections and promoting overall health.
